author: Kingtonton
quote:
I'm not sure there has ever been a game in a major franchise that has so thoroughly and completely spit in the face of everything that the franchise represents. 

Characters are bland and uninteresting, there are not wacky hijinks, outrageous heists, characters bigger than life. 

I don't care about anyone complaining about any other political this or sexism that. It just isn't fun.

It's like Rockstar has been building for decades towards finally turning their games into mind-numbingly boring lifesims and they have finally done it. 

Why shoot people and rob banks when you can do chores?

author: Kingtonton
quote:
This is the game that puts other open-world games to shame. 

I loathe open-world for all its time-wasting, meandering, boring, pointlessness. Witcher 3 changed my mind on all of that. The combat isn't the most exciting, but who cares when the sidequests, almost every single one to a T, are the best storytelling you've ever seen? Constantly feeling like your choice matters, constantly feeling like there is no 'right or wrong' there is only what you have Geralt do.

Also, Triss is 10/10 and Yenn is a hateful trashy *****. Yeah, I said it.

author: Kingtonton
quote:
Does it have a lot of minigames? Yes. Are some of the minigames so insidiously evil (I'm looking at you final piano minigame challenge) that you want to rip out your eyes? Yes. Does the game still deliver on every single front, like somehow making Red XIII and Yuffie (two of the lamest characters in the OG) the most fun to play in combat? Absolutely. 

The original game is an insanely complex mix of mythologies and religions (Midgar, and Nibelheim obviously from Norse mythology, Sephiroth from the Kabbalah) with psychological mysteries and unreliable narratives. 

Rebirth doesn't disappoint in complexity, and right up until the very end, a lot of people will be wondering what happened. 

The game managed to respect the original while building on the foundation and telling what will hopefully be the final conclusion of Cloud's story. The best linear RPG hands down.

author: Kingtonton
quote:
Make a game called a remake that's actually a sequel but filter out 99% of people that just don't get it and realize something is happening and instead complain that Tifa's boobs aren't big enough.

Best graphics in a video game, amazing soundtrack, complex combat that manages to somehow take the strategy of turn-based and the excitement of action RPGs.

Great voice acting too. Who knew Barret existed somewhere in the real world and I would get to see him?
